main_text.l: tum Arabicum & Syriacum jam à Ga-
nas versiones; hæc omnia tam pauculo
hic subsisteret, invitavit; sed nihil se
rant & avent, atque ego existimo, de re
literaria esse, ut revertatur: quæ enim ad
gere potest, quàm à viro tanto amari &
J. Morinus Cardinali Barberino. De eodem Argumento.

page.notes: Long s printed as f throughout, transcribed as s. Paragraph break before "Quidquid" is set mid-line after "conficiuntur." and was taken as a new paragraph; "Qvid enim" after "accipio." was taken as continuing the paragraph. The mark over the final e of "obsequiosê" is faint and uncertain. Printed "Quidquid" and "Quid" use the Q with v-form u, normalised to u.
